subject: geo
alt: Grade 9 learners studying Human Development Index components: life expectancy, education, and income
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 9 learners showing the three pillars of the Human Development Index. Display: a stethoscope/health symbol (life expectancy), books/education symbol, and money/income symbol. Use distinct colors for each pillar, simple flat design, clean white background, and no text except labels.

subject: geo
alt: Grade 9 learners understanding colonial legacy and unequal trade patterns between developed and developing countries
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 9 learners showing trade imbalance. Show two regions: one exporting raw materials (minerals, agricultural products) and one exporting manufactured goods. Use arrows to show trade flow, different colors for developed vs developing countries, simple flat design, clean white background, and minimal text labels.

subject: geo
alt: Grade 9 learners seeing the three pillars of sustainable development: environment, society, and economy
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 9 learners showing three overlapping circles representing the three pillars of sustainability: Environment (green, nature symbols), Society (blue, people symbols), and Economy (yellow, money symbols). Show their intersection in the middle. Use bright colors, clean white background, simple flat style, and minimal text labels.

subject: geo
alt: Grade 9 learners learning about South African development areas: education, infrastructure, healthcare, and employment
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 9 learners showing South African development areas.
